title: Server Information

sections.heading: Miracle 7.4
content: Miracle 7.4 is a long-term hardcore project, based on the cipsoft original files. We aim to build a unique server with our own identity while remaining as faithful as possible to the 7.4 mechanics. All the original quests, items, NPCs and maps are present in the game, including new mysteries to be discovered.

sections.heading: General Information
content: World Type: PvP Server Save: 05:00 GMT-3 Map Clean: Monday Host Location: US

sections.heading: Frag System
content: Kills to Red Skull: 3 daily, 5 weekly, 10 monthly Red Skull Time: 15 days Kills to Banishment: 6 daily, 10 weekly, 20 monthly Banishment Time: 15 days

sections.heading: Houses
content: House Price: 200gp per sqm + 1000gp per bed Rent Info: 30% of house price per 15 days Max Account Sleepers: 2 Bed Regeneration: 1 hp/mana per min until 5 * current food time

sections.heading: Stamina
content: Normal (Until 40:00): 1/5 min online, 1/2.5 min offline Green (After 40:00): 1/10 min online, 1/5 min offline Online stamina regen will start after the character not gain exp for at least 3 minutes.
For 14 hours of stamina or lower, experience will be reduced in -50% and all creatures won't provide more loot.
Stamina system does not provide any kind of bonus on green stage.
